verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਆਰ ਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਹੀ ਸੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਭਲੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਹ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aaisee naikaa mai kuaar paatr hee supaatr bhalee aas piaasee maataa pitaa ekai kaeh dhet hai ||

en.bdb: A virgin maid who is ever hopeful of achieving a place of superior authority in the house of a husband that her father will find for her one day is far better than a deceitful woman.

verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਭਲੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਇ ਲਾਇ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aaisee naikaa mai dheenataa kai dhuhaagan bhalee patit paavan pria pai lai let hai ||

en.bdb: A woman who has been disassociated with her husband by him and who regrets her actions by her humility, consequence of which her husband forgives her sins is far better than a deceitful woman.

verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਸੈ ਭਲੋ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਓਗ ਸੋਗ ਲਗਨ ਸਗਨ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਹੇਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aaisee naikaa sai bhalo birahaa biog sog lagan sagan sodhe saradhaa sahet hai ||

en.bdb: That woman separated from her husband who bearing the pangs of separation is devotedly involved in finding out auspicious time and good omens for the reunion is better than a treacherous and deceitful woman.

verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਭਲੀ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਹੁ ਕੇਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੦॥
verses.translit_en: aaisee naikaa maat garabh hee galee bhalee kapaT saneh dhubidhaa jiau raahu ket hai ||450||

en.bdb: Such a woman of deceitful love should have perished in her mother's womb. Deceit filled love is full of such duality as the two demons Rahu and Ketu are who cause solar and lunar eclipse.  (450)
